critical_path: the 11 REDUCE ROOTS are the critical path: root TRISC span 213us = gateup 54 + compute_reduce 116 + swiglu 3 + down 37 + out_pack 2. The other 99 cores idle-wait (their compute_down 120-150us and reader_phase2 90-177us are cb_wait, not work).

ranked_headroom.1_root_reduce_eltwise: 116us on the root vs a ~15-30us eltwise roofline (384 bfp8 tile-adds + 48 SiLU tiles). 4 SEQUENTIAL child round trips at ~(4us transfer + 20us add). 208 ns/tile = ~281 cycles/tile against ~34-70. HEADROOM ~86-100us. This is the textbook eltwise_l1_vs_dest_accumulate RMW anti-pattern: cb_gate_acc/cb_up_acc are bfloat8_b and are UNPACKED+ADDED+PACKED once per child.

ranked_headroom.2_gateup_matmul: 54us mean / 34.6us min vs ~19-35us unpack roofline; but it is ALSO the window in which 16.5MB of gate/up bfp4 is pulled at ~306 GB/s, so partly DRAM-bound. HEADROOM ~19us, tangled.

ranked_headroom.3_gateup_reduce_serialisation: gateup(54) and reduce(116) are STRICTLY SERIAL on the root — op_design.md 4.3s per-sub-block overlap was never built (R2 turned HN_BLOCK but not the reduce split). HEADROOM up to 54us.

ranked_headroom.4_down_matmul: 37us on the root (min 29.3us) vs ~17-30us roofline. HEADROOM 7-20us.

ranked_headroom.5_x_stage_tilize: compute_tilize up to 40us / reader_xstage up to 37us on injector cores (32 stick reads of 1472B per tile-row) — OVERLAP-HIDDEN at count 256 (those cores total 214us < the 221us stragglers) but relatively larger at the graded count 128.

roofline_gates.weight_dram_stream: GATED OUT. 24.772 MB of bfp4 at 512 GB/s = 48.4us floor; measured incremental 50.6us = 1.04x roofline. At the DRAM roofline — no headroom. Kills the WRUN / dual-NoC / prefetch-depth idea class (consistent with R2/R3 having already measured those null).

roofline_gates.h_all_gather: GATED OUT as a transport. 14.1us incremental for 11 rounds of a 110-core rendezvous + 11x52KB mcast = 1.3us/round. Cheap. reader_phase2s 143us wall is WAITING FOR THE ROOTS, not transport.

roofline_gates.output_write: GATED OUT. 1.95 MB bfp8 = 3.8us at peak; compute_out_pack 1.6us, writer_out_issue is 99% cb_wait.

conclusion: The op is NOT transport-bound and NOT weight-DRAM-bound. It is bound by the SERIAL ELTWISE WORK ON 11 OF 110 CORES. 70% of the idea budget goes to the root reduce.

what: ELTWISE_BLK — blocked eltwise DEST windows on every eltwise pass of the compute kernel
predicate: UNCONDITIONAL over the whole SUPPORTED set. The lever is a per-call CB-lifecycle policy, not a shape property: PerChunk wait/pop/reserve/push + OperandKind::Block + EltwiseShape::tiles(n, 8). BlockTailSync::ValidTiles makes the ragged final window synchronize only its remainder, so per-CB totals are unchanged at every m_eff (6/12/24/48 tiles) and the cross-core reduce accounting is untouched. ELTWISE_BLK=1 is the A/B knob.
regressions: NONE — all 12 perf cells faster; golden 45/45; 3 exact structural debug tests still exact
raw_llk: none — the graduated path is pure kernel_lib (eltwise_convenience specs); no helper bypass
